description: Figure 10 is a grouped bar chart that illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks, categorized by language family. The horizontal axis displays different language families, including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the "effect," with a scale ranging from 0 to 30. For each language family, there are five bars, each corresponding to a different model: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), and mBERT-B₂ (light red), with XLM-B₂ (dark red) being the fifth. The height of each bar indicates the magnitude of the effect, with error bars representing the standard deviation. The chart shows that the effect varies significantly across language families and models. For instance, in the IE-Indic family, the mBERT-B₂ model shows the highest effect, reaching approximately 25, while in the Uralic family, the effects are generally low for all models. The mBERT-L₂ model consistently shows the lowest effect across most language families.
